stories.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
stories.take: Anthropic wants a federal safety law with teeth — a model could be blocked if it could kill 50+ people — but agencies would need a judge's sign-off to stop a release.

stories.title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
stories.take: Anthropic is struggling to lock down enough compute from cloud partners who increasingly see it as a rival, even as spending balloons ahead of a planned November IPO.

stories.title: SpaceX and Tesla boards form special committees to review merger
stories.take: Both boards formed independent committees to review a SpaceX-Tesla merger Musk calls a good idea — he says he sits on neither committee.

stories.title: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
stories.take: SpaceX turned profitable in Q3 with $4.4 billion in net income, and AI — not rockets alone — was the engine.

stories.title: Meta drops the word "train" from its commercial TOS after AI backlash
stories.take: Meta quietly removed 'train' from its commercial terms after the AI scraping backlash, but still won't add language honoring robots.txt.

stories.title: Meta Muse exposes users' personal and business secrets when they share conversations
stories.take: A share-link flaw in Meta's Muse exposed users' personal and business secrets; Meta is suspending sharing while it investigates.

stories.title: PHP warns it plans to release 2 emergency patches imminently
stories.take: PHP maintainers warn two emergency patches are imminent amid reports of a remote-code-execution exploit — patch fast when they land.

stories.title: The Internet goes on high alert after discovery of 8 compromised TLS certs
stories.take: Eight compromised intermediate TLS certificates would let anyone mint credentials for any server — the internet is on high alert.

stories.title: Gemini's Personal Intelligence is coming to cars
stories.take: Gemini's Personal Intelligence is coming to cars, drawing on your Google data for personalized answers — time to audit those Gemini settings.

stories.title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
stories.take: Google joined Amazon with a developer tool that makes it easier for PyTorch apps to move off Nvidia GPUs — the CUDA moat is the target.

stories.title: Quantum error correction goes well beyond breakeven
stories.take: A new demo shows error-corrected qubits cutting errors sharply as they scale — quantum error correction well beyond breakeven.

stories.title: Salesforce to Buy Braze for $5.66 Billion
stories.take: Salesforce is buying Braze for $5.66 billion to feed real-time customer-behavior signals into its AI marketing stack.

stories.title: Netflix lowers ad revenue forecast by 10%, continues to beef up ad suite
stories.take: Netflix cut its ad revenue forecast 10% to about $2.7 billion on a slower capabilities rollout, even as Q3 revenue grew 12%.

stories.title: Apple Music Rebrands With a Look Made by Sound
stories.take: Apple Music's new identity, built with TBWA\Media Arts Lab and Fred Again, turns ripples of sound into the brand's visual language.

stories.title: Target Ditches ‘Hot Santa’ for D’Arcy Carden in First Holiday Campaign Under New CEO
stories.take: Target swaps 'Hot Santa' for D'Arcy Carden in its first holiday campaign under the new CEO — a softer, funnier reset for the season.

stories.title: Substack Brings Dynamic Ad Insertion to Podcasts
stories.take: Substack is bringing dynamic ad insertion to podcasts — creators can sell their own campaigns or fill breaks via marketplaces, with monetization slated for 2027.

stories.title: Pitch Deck: Cuttable Raises $20M to Turn Brands’ Photos and Videos Into Meta Ads
stories.take: Cuttable raised $20M to turn brands' existing photos and video into Meta ads — betting creative is the last part of ad buying left to automate.

stories.title: Whatnot Launches Its First National Spot as Live Shopping Finally Starts Gaining Traction
stories.take: Whatnot's first national spot, starring Cam Skattebo, lands as live shopping finally gains traction with Gen Z.

stories.title: Indie agencies want The Trade Desk and Amazon DSP to acknowledge their buying power with negotiating leverage
stories.take: Indie agencies say The Trade Desk and Amazon DSP block direct seats and fee relief despite real spend commitments — they want their buying power recognized.

stories.title: CNN Redesigns Website Homepage, Showcases New Video Offerings
stories.take: CNN redesigned its homepage around insights from All Access, putting its new video offerings front and center.

stories.title: 76ers take down defending champion Knicks in season opener
stories.take: The 76ers spoiled the Knicks' ring night, beating the defending champions in the season opener.

stories.title: LeBron moonlights at center, helps limit Towns in winning debut for Sixers
stories.take: LeBron opened his 24th season at center for stretches, posting 14 points, 9 rebounds and 7 assists to help limit Towns in a winning Sixers debut.

stories.title: Wemby starts 0-for-12 in career-worst night: 'Might be overthinking it'
stories.take: Wembanyama started 0-for-12 and shot a career-worst 8% as the Thunder got revenge on the Spurs — 'might be overthinking it.'

stories.title: Pistons pull off 22-point comeback vs. Celtics, NBA's largest on first day of a season
stories.take: Detroit rallied from 22 down to beat Boston — the largest opening-day comeback in the play-by-play era.

stories.title: Around the World, Paris and 'giddiness': The dawn of the Ant-Melo era in Minnesota
stories.take: The Ant-Melo era is here: LaMelo Ball joins Anthony Edwards in Minnesota, and the vibe is pure giddiness ahead of tonight's debut vs. Giannis and Miami.

stories.title: The 5 biggest questions still facing Luka Doncic and the Lakers
stories.take: A transformative offseason still leaves five big unanswered questions for Luka Doncic and the Lakers, starting tonight vs. the Warriors.

stories.title: Karl-Anthony Towns confirms he's willing to take less money from Knicks amid halted contract extension talks
stories.take: Towns says a max deal was 'nowhere' in his mind and he's willing to take less from the Knicks as extension talks sit paused.

stories.title: The small-ball World Series? How the Brewers and Rays fit -- and don't fit -- the narrative
stories.take: Brewers-Rays is a small-market, small-ball Fall Classic on the surface — dig deeper and the matchup is stranger and better than the narrative.

stories.title: Jacob Misiorowski gets World Series Game 1 start for Brewers as he looks to reclaim his ace stuff
stories.take: Jacob Misiorowski gets the Game 1 start for Milwaukee on Friday, looking to reclaim his ace stuff after two short playoff outings.

stories.title: Caminero's unlikely blast, 38.7-second HR trot punctuate Rays' pennant-clinching win
stories.take: Junior Caminero's first career postseason homer — off All-Star closer Cade Smith, with a 38.7-second trot — punctuated the Rays' pennant-clinching win.

stories.title: 'Fastball Freddy' Peralta named ALCS MVP after pitching Rays into World Series
stories.take: Freddy Peralta rode his fastball to ALCS MVP, pitching the Rays into the World Series.

stories.title: GM Cashman 'locked and loaded' with new Yankees deal
stories.take: Brian Cashman has a new deal to stay Yankees GM — the post he's held since 1998.

stories.title: Brewers address $1,000 'Timeless Ticket' debacle as fans try to cash in for World Series
stories.take: Milwaukee is making amends after its 2015 $1,000 'Timeless Ticket' — redeemable for any future game — met World Series reality.

stories.title: MLB qualifying offer for free agents rises to $23.15M, up 5.1% from 2025
stories.take: This year's qualifying offer rises 5.1% to $23.15 million, setting the price tag for top free agents.

stories.title: Trump leans into unprecedented power ahead of midterm elections
stories.take: Less than two weeks before the midterms, Trump keeps crashing through barriers he wouldn't have crossed in his first term.

stories.title: Likely voters prefer Democrats to Republicans in latest poll ahead of midterms as Trump’s popularity continues to sink – live
stories.take: Likely voters prefer Democrats by 11 points in the latest poll as Trump's popularity keeps sinking heading into the midterms.

stories.title: Michael Bloomberg spends $80m on Democrats as Trump moves $400m to Republican candidates
stories.take: Bloomberg is putting $80 million behind Democrats' House push while Trump moves $400 million to Republicans — the money race is lopsided.

stories.title: State attorneys general step up plans to counter Trump’s meddling in midterms
stories.take: Democratic attorneys general are coordinating — calls, tabletop exercises — to counter Trump's midterm interference.

stories.title: Supreme Court upholds pause on Trump's anti-trans prison policy
stories.take: The Supreme Court kept gender-affirming care in place for federal inmates while the fight over Trump's prison policy continues.

stories.title: Putin agrees to resume trilateral Russia-Ukraine-U.S. talks next month
stories.take: Putin agreed in principle to resume trilateral Russia-Ukraine-U.S. talks after Nov. 10, following his meeting with U.S. envoy Witkoff.

stories.title: Russia releases imprisoned U.S. citizen Stephen Hubbard following Trump's request
stories.take: Russia freed American Stephen Hubbard after more than four years in prison, following Trump's request during the Witkoff visit.

stories.title: Chemical tank explosion in Ohio of glycidyl methacrylate forces evacuations, prompts fears of another blast
stories.take: A chemical tank explosion in Ohio forced evacuations, with fears of a second blast from the burning compound.

stories.title: DOJ's noncitizen voter list is unreliable, officials say. And, U.S. pollution rises
stories.take: California officials call the DOJ's 'likely' noncitizen voter list unreliable, and a UN report shows a major rise in U.S. climate pollution.

stories.title: Severely ill ICE detainees face imminent deportation to unknown African states, advocates say
stories.take: Advocates say gravely ill ICE detainees in Florida face imminent deportation to African countries where they have no ties, on flights as early as Wednesday.

stories.title: Big California state worker strike set to begin today
stories.take: California state workers begin a one-day strike today in Sacramento, San Francisco and Los Angeles over pay cuts — maybe skip the DMV.

stories.title: New storm moves into Southern California: What to expect
stories.take: A new storm brings scattered showers to Southern California Wednesday into Thursday.

stories.title: ‘Borders on the absurd.’ California fights Trump lawsuit to set aside 20,000 ballots
stories.take: California's attorney general called the Trump lawsuit to set aside up to 20,000 ballots 'bordering on the absurd' and asked a judge to block it.

stories.title: Feds hold back an additional $1.2 billion in California Medicaid reimbursements
stories.take: The administration is deferring another $1.2 billion in California Medicaid funds, on top of $1.3 billion held back in May.

stories.title: Vital Central Valley flood control levees are poorly maintained, state watchdog finds
stories.take: Nearly a third of Central Valley levee agencies have done 'unacceptable' upkeep for years, and the state hasn't stepped in as the law requires.

stories.title: Lopez: Disney built the monorail in a year. LAX's people mover, almost 8, hasn't left the station
stories.take: LAX's SkyLink people mover is nearly eight years in, ballooned from $1.9B to $3.3B, and still hasn't left the station — now with a grand jury probe.

stories.title: What to know about California’s other tax-the-rich measure: Prop. 3
stories.take: Prop. 3 would make California's tax-the-rich measure permanent before it expires in 2031 — voters first passed it in 2012.

stories.title: California woman makes history by swimming state's 900-mile length. She did it so you don't have to
stories.take: Catherine Breed, 33, swam California's entire 900-mile coast from Oregon to Mexico, July to October — a first.

stories.title: Is This Economy as Awful as Voters Think? We Ask Our Expert.
stories.take: The answer: the economy has real strengths — 4.2% unemployment, record stocks, solid spending — but an affordability crisis drives voter anger • Inflation stalled at 3.7% on tariffs and the Iran war's oil spike; gas hit $4.45/gal • The Fed hiked in September, pushing mortgage rates to ~7.5%, and real wages are flat since Trump returned • Structural costs — housing, childcare, $1T/yr debt service — persist past the midterms whoever wins

stories.title: Zelenskyy Mending Ties, Trump In North Carolina, Saudi Arabia Gets British Support
stories.take: Zelenskyy met envoy Witkoff in Oslo pushing for face-to-face Putin talks, while Ukrainians distrust a White House they see siding with Russia • Trump rallied in Greenville, NC, admitting GOP Senate hopeful Michael Watley trails Roy Cooper by double digits — 'I got him into this. I hope it works' • The UK is sending RAF jets on a purely defensive mission to shield Saudi cities from Houthi attacks; 250,000+ displaced in Yemen

stories.title: Tesla and SpaceX Weigh a Mega Merger
stories.take: Musk confirmed special committees are weighing a Tesla-SpaceX merger — a combined ~$3.5 trillion valuation, citing chip, AI and robotics synergies; shareholders must approve • SpaceX shares jumped nearly 10% on its first profit as a public company; Netflix fell 5%+ off-hours on its slowest revenue growth in years • Randstad's CEO sees no evidence of AI hitting the labor market at scale — disruption is limited to admin, clerical, finance, marketing and customer-service pockets

stories.title: Is Nvidia Selling More Chips Than Anyone Can Use?
stories.take: The answer: yes — Ed Zitron argues Nvidia is channel-stuffing, forcing hyperscalers to take $3B+/month of GPU racks early with no path to install them • ~$374B in construction-in-progress sits across CoreWeave, SpaceX, Amazon and Google (Google alone >$100B); Amazon is spending $220B on AI this year • Microsoft has ~2 GW of actual AI capacity vs. 12 GW claimed, and idle GPUs are driving up RAM and consumer electronics prices

stories.title: Netflix in Turmoil + Derek Thompson on AI & The Antisocial Century
stories.take: Netflix laid off ~1,000 people and lost its top content chiefs in one week; Peter Rice takes over as CCO as the 'gourmet cheeseburger' era ends — stock down ~40% YoY and a reported ~$80B Warner Bros. Discovery bid spooked the market • Kafka: with 300M+ subscribers and <2% churn, the real rival is YouTube and TikTok, not Disney • Derek Thompson on his 'Three A's': data-center construction is up 60% while hospitals, housing and offices fall — AI is crowding out building for people

stories.title: James Robinson on What It Looks Like When a State is Failing
stories.take: Robinson: the US is not a failed state, but shows inclusion failure — trust in institutions is 'horrifying' and non-college incomes are flat for 50 years; Trump is a symptom of that discontent • Inclusive vs. extractive institutions remain the core frame: transitions are domestically driven (Chile), with no universal playbook • On China, extractive politics with inclusive-ish economics will eventually 'go off the rails' — absolute power corrupts

stories.title: The case for sharing your salary
stories.take: Data journalist Mona Chalabi — who discloses her own $850,000 book advance — profiles 10 Americans, one per income decile, from $30,000/yr to $500,000+/yr • The '1% vs. 99%' frame lets most people hide behind 'middle class' (54% self-identify that way); granular money talk exposes real relative economic power • Financial anxiety appears at every level, driven by consumerism plus housing, healthcare and life shocks

stories.title: Corona High shooting plot arrests, Flood Watch ahead of storm, UCLA & USC preseason basketball rankings — Morning Edition
stories.take: Two teenage girls were arrested on conspiracy charges after the FBI tipped Corona police to a planned shooting at Corona High — months of research, but no weapons obtained • A flood watch starts this afternoon with Santa Monica Mountains risk; most of LA/Orange counties get ~1 inch, more in hills • Tens of thousands of state workers strike for one day today — DMV and unemployment offices may be limited; Lakers and Clippers open tonight, and USC women are No. 3 in the AP preseason poll with JuJu Watkins back
